senior_subject: English Home Language / First Additional Language

bloom_distribution.stance: moderate scaffold, longer source handling, early comparison and justified choices

caps_focus: multi-paragraph comprehension, language-in-context, summary and guided transactional writing

questions.prompt_shape: Describe or explain the meaning of evidence in a Grade 8 English Language stimulus or task.
